scope: Original CCINIClass::GetCRC 476D80 over physically loaded INI files: retail RULESMD/ARTMD/AIMD, the nine MPModesMD mode INIs and COOPCAMPMD (plus an AIMD digest=0 contrast), seventeen synthetic parser/serializer controls with their exact SaveToPipe streams, and one original Rules/Art/AI composite run (679D90, 679EC0, 679ED0)
assumptions: Each control runs the original INI constructor 535B30 (latch +40 cleared, vtable 7E1AF4, as the allocation at 52CF56..52CF60), CCFileClass 4739F0 and ReadCCFile 4741F0 with the game's arguments: RULESMD (0,0) at 52CF73, ARTMD (0,0) at 52D053/679F0D, AIMD (1,0) at 52D378, mode INIs (0,0) at 5D685A, COOPCAMPMD (0,0) at 679E3B. GetCRC then runs unchanged; EAX is its CRCEngine 4A1DE0 result.

Retail bytes are read from the checkout's machine-local ini/ (case-insensitive) and are not stored; only file name, byte length and native outputs are. Mode file names come from original ReadString 528A10 on the native MPMODESMD load for the six LoadAllGameModes section literals; the third comma token is split and trimmed in Python in place of Wstring getToken.
SaveToPipe streams are every SHAPipe::Put 69E9B0 call on GetCRC's own pipe between 476DDA and 476DDF, observed read-only. put_stream_sha1_is_digest is a capture-completeness check only.

Composite: [887048] holds a fresh native RULESMD load, ART/AI load into their static owners 887180/887128. The MultiplayerGameMode registry at ABFDA0 is seeded with nine id-sorted objects carrying id +28, file name Wstring +2C and a null cached INI +38, so original 5D67B0 constructs, checks Exists and loads each mode file. The native StringTable/Initializer construction of those objects does not run. COOPCAMPMD is loaded by 679D90 itself with its latch B053B8 clear. Later in-game edits to these INI objects before the CRC, map/LANGRULE layering and the network exchange are outside coverage.
substitutions: Existing RetailRulesHistory/BulletReader Windows/file/heap/CRT/TLS platform transport and declared physical file bytes only; no INI parser, SaveToPipe, SHA, CRCEngine or composite body is replaced. Original mapped code bytes are checked unchanged.
